subject: Separate pending OpenSSH Server inbound firewall setting

safety_boundaries: Does not install or remove the OpenSSH Server capability.
Does not start or stop sshd.
Does not create firewall rules or alter unrelated rules.
Requires the capability to be installed and the exact local inbound TCP/22 allow rule to exist.
Refuses a same-name rule if its direction, action, profile, local policy store, protocol, or port differs from the bounded identity.

coverage: Catalog metadata and discovery classify the rule as a setting, not a component.
The handler captures and restores the exact enabled flag.
Missing capability and missing rule fail closed without mutation.
A same-name rule with a non-TCP/22 port is rejected before mutation.
Existing Remote Desktop firewall and other network-control tests pass.
